about: Real DC hours: every hour of 2025, from Open-Meteo's 2025 historical forecast (38.911,-76.986), which labelled them at a fixed UTC-4 (so a winter hour's label runs an hour ahead of DC's clock); the hours run from start, a true instant, an hour apart. Sunrise and sunset are computed for DC from the standard sunrise equation (within a minute or two of the published times), as [date, sunrise, sunset], the same way as sun-cover-weeks-2025.json, whose weeks are cut from these same hours. Built 2026-09-25 for scripts/weather-check.ts's sweep of the 24-hour view's paw and leaf times at a phone's size, with now at every hour of the year; each row's columns follow `keys`.
